item.tib: dmar khrid dug lnga rang grol gyi rgyud las skyabs gnas bla ma'i gsang sgrub
item.coloph: zhes skyabs gnas bla ma'i gsang sgrub 'di yang / kun bzang dgongs pa'i lung bstan ltar/ khyung dkar sprang 'khyams pas gang dran 'di rnams/ bal bod sa mtshams sbas yul gnam sgo zla gam can du smras pa bkra shis su gyur cig/
